tasks.original_prompt:
Latest hemoglobin still below normal for this patient? Then flag that report with a follow-up task; if not, don't touch the chart.
Context: patient MRN SYN-450ee8e8be (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2025-05-08, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order. A result is low when its value is below 12.0 g/dL for a patient whose Patient.gender is female and below 13.0 g/dL otherwise. answer is {"latest": ..., "still_low": ..., "task_created": ...}. latest is the most recent result, with exactly these keys: date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit); still_low (boolean) is whether it is low; both are null when no result was ever low. Only when still_low is true, create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference and $report with the DiagnosticReport whose basedOn references the ServiceRequest the latest result's basedOn references and whose result lists the latest result: {"resourceType": "Task", "status": "requested", "intent": "order", "for": {"reference": "$patient"}, "focus": {"reference": "$report"}}. task_created (boolean) is whether you created it. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the latest result, and its DiagnosticReport when you create the Task; when no result was ever low, every hemoglobin result considered), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.
tasks.prompt:
SYN-450ee8e8be: as of 2025-05-08, if the latest hemoglobin is still low, add a follow-up task on that lab report; otherwise leave the chart unchanged.
Reply with only JSON: {"answer": {latest: {date: date YYYY-MM-DD, unit: text, value: number}, still_low: true/false, task_created: true/false}, "evidence": [references of the records you used, Type/id]}. Use null for any value the chart does not have.
tasks.prompt_before_v023: SYN-450ee8e8be: as of 2025-05-08, if the latest hemoglobin is still low, add a follow-up task to that lab report; otherwise do nothing.
required_changes: only if the patient's most recent hemoglobin is low, add a follow-up task for the patient on the lab report listing that result; otherwise change nothing
rewrite_changes: only if the patient's most recent hemoglobin is low, create a new Task (status requested, intent order) for the patient whose focus is the lab report (DiagnosticReport) listing that most recent result; otherwise change nothing
